exhaustive_scope: The frozen PDF, complete arXiv source archive inventory, and sole top-level TeX file were searched for the non-optimal observables A1/A2, their normalized matrices and adjoints, output-port POVM elements/probabilities, and Supplemental Material. The source archive contains no Supplemental Material file.
conclusion: The two targets are objectively publication-underspecified. Their missing mathematical objects are required to evaluate the observables and probabilities; they are not stochastic seeds, rendering choices, or independently selectable numerical-method settings.
